blurb.zh: 从最短的一篇读起，再读他的小说集和回忆散文。
blurb.en: Begin with the shortest story, then the collections and the memoir essays.

why.zh: 中国现代小说的开篇，一篇就能读完。
why.en: The story that began modern Chinese fiction; one sitting.

why.zh: 最有名的一个人物，和“精神胜利法”。
why.en: The most famous character, and his “spiritual victory”.

why.zh: 《狂人日记》《阿Q正传》都收在里面，其余篇目接着读。
why.en: It holds both of the above; go on with the rest.

why.zh: 《呐喊》之后的第二本小说集，笔调更冷。
why.en: The second collection of stories, colder in tone.

why.zh: 回忆童年和师友的散文，最容易读。
why.en: Memoir essays on childhood and teachers; the easiest to read.

blurb.zh: 中国古典小说的四座高峰，想读哪一部都可以从第一回开始。
blurb.en: Four summits of classical Chinese fiction; start any of them at chapter one.

why.zh: 最适合从头读起的一部，热闹，章回短。
why.en: The easiest to begin with: lively, short chapters.

why.zh: 从黄巾起义到三分归晋，人物最多。
why.en: From the Yellow Turbans to the end of the three kingdoms; the biggest cast.

why.zh: 一百零八个好汉上梁山。
why.en: Outlaws gather on Liangshan: a hundred and eight of them.

why.zh: 一个家族的盛衰，也是写得最细的一部。
why.en: The rise and fall of a family; the most finely drawn.

blurb.zh: 都不长，一本一本读，不用按顺序。
blurb.en: None is long; read them one by one, in any order.

why.zh: 孔子和弟子的对话，一句一句读。
why.en: Confucius and his students in short exchanges.

why.zh: 五千字，读一遍用不了半小时。
why.en: Five thousand characters; one pass takes half an hour.

why.zh: 寓言最多、最好读的一本。
why.en: Full of parables; the most readable.

why.zh: 最短的兵书，也常被当作处世的书。
why.en: The shortest book on war, often read as a book on life.

why.zh: 想读别的先秦著作，到这里找。
why.en: For other early texts, look here.

blurb.zh: 句子不绕、故事好看，适合第一次整本读英文。
blurb.en: Plain sentences and good stories: for reading a whole book in English for the first time.

why.zh: 句子短，故事怪，读起来不累。
why.en: Short sentences and a strange story; easy going.

why.zh: 一篇一个案子，随时能停。
why.en: One case per story; stop whenever you like.

why.zh: 很短，十二章就读完。
why.en: Short: twelve chapters and it is done.

why.zh: 冒险故事，节奏快。
why.en: A fast adventure.

why.zh: 八十天环游世界，章节短而紧凑。
why.en: Eighty days round the world, in short, tight chapters.

why.zh: 再进一步：长一些，对话多。
why.en: A step up: longer, full of dialogue.

name.en: Science fiction and mystery, a century old

blurb.zh: 今天的科幻片、恐怖片、侦探剧，很多从这几本来。
blurb.en: Much of today’s science fiction, horror and detective stories comes from these.

why.zh: 科幻的起点之一。
why.en: One of the places science fiction began.

why.zh: 时间旅行的老祖宗。
why.en: The grandfather of time travel.

why.zh: 外星人入侵的老祖宗。
why.en: The original alien invasion.

why.zh: 用书信和日记拼出来的恐怖故事。
why.en: Horror told through letters and diaries.

why.zh: 一幅画替他变老。
why.en: A portrait grows old in his place.

why.zh: 侦探小说的样板。
why.en: The pattern of the detective story.

blurb.zh: 从上手到打底子，都是免费在线读的。
blurb.en: From first steps to foundations, all free to read online.

why.zh: 边读边在页面上改代码、跑代码。
why.en: Edit and run the code as you read.

why.zh: 用中文把 ES6 讲清楚。
why.en: ES6 explained in Chinese.

why.zh: 把 Git 讲到底层。
why.en: Git, down to how it works.

why.zh: 官方的 Rust 入门书，中文版。
why.en: The official Rust book, in Chinese.

why.zh: 把命令行从头学一遍。
why.en: Learn the command line from the start.

why.zh: 计算机科学的一本老经典。
why.en: An old classic of computer science.

why.zh: 自己动手写一个解释器。
why.en: Write an interpreter yourself.

blurb.zh: 教材和杂志各有一些，不用懂很多也能读。
blurb.en: Some textbooks and some magazines; no need to know much first.

why.zh: 微积分的入门书，笔调轻松。
why.en: A light-hearted first book of calculus.

why.zh: 大学基础课的开放教材。
why.en: Open textbooks for first-year courses.

why.zh: 一套物理教材，免费读。
why.en: A set of physics textbooks, free to read.

why.zh: 数学和科学的长文报道。
why.en: Long reads on mathematics and science.

why.zh: 百年前的科普杂志，看当时怎么讲科学。
why.en: A century-old science magazine: how science was told then.

blurb.zh: 狐仙、异兽、海外奇国，都是短篇，翻到哪读到哪。
blurb.en: Fox spirits, strange beasts and far countries; short pieces, open anywhere.

why.zh: 狐仙鬼怪的短篇故事，一篇一篇读。
why.en: Short tales of fox spirits and ghosts.

why.zh: 最早的神话和异兽。
why.en: The oldest myths and beasts.

why.zh: 魏晋名士的小故事。
why.en: Small stories of the scholars of the Wei–Jin era.

why.zh: 唐敖出海，游历君子国、女儿国。
why.en: A sea voyage to the land of gentlemen and the land of women.

why.zh: 取经路上的妖魔。
why.en: Demons on the road to the scriptures.
